tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Top GitHub repos by stars gained today (last 24 hours), this week (7 days) or this month (30 days), or by total stars (window "all"). Optional language or topic filter. Use list_filters for valid names.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Details of one tracked repo by owner/name: stars, forks, language, license, topics, star counts of the last days, gains and ranks per window.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Find tracked repos by words in the name, description, topics or language. Every word must match. Results are ordered by relevance, then stars.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List the languages or the GitHub topics that get_trending and search_repos accept, with how many tracked repos each has. Most repos first.

tools.name: how_we_rank
tools.description: Plain explanation of how RepoTrending counts stars gained, which repos it tracks, what it leaves out and how much data each window has so far.
